text:
maya: Quick heads-up — QBR prep for Helix onboarding: their token usage spiked ~3x last week. Need a cost scrub before Friday. @priya ?
priya: saw that. onboarding ramp + embed-heavy tests. I can pull hour-by-hour trace, but need the sample prompt set from them.
maya: they attached a short list in the ticket (link). Carlos, can you join to propose throttle/guardrail options?
carlos: Yep. Levers I'd use: prefix/KV caching, per-route max_tokens=256, and a quantization profile for their model. Rough estimate: ~40% token reduction with caching on their flows.
ethan: If 40% holds, monthly spend drops from ~$12k to ~$7k. Need to validate with duty-cycle. @maya, do we have their projected call volume for the QBR deck?
maya: they estimate ~1.2M tokens/month by EOM if tests keep running. Renewal in ~30 days — we need a crisp cost story for the QBR.
priya: I'll run a simulation against the live usage trace and output CSV + percentile breakdown. ETA 3 hrs.
carlos: Also suggest soft quota alert at 60% of commit + auto-fallback to a cheaper model for spikes. That reduces churn risk.
maya: can we capture enablement asks for the customer workshop? want clear actionables: (1) trim prompt templates (2) enable KV caching (3) batch window 50ms recommendation (4) per-route quotas + alerts
priya: added that checklist to the enablement doc and pinged the customer's PM for a 1-hr workshop slot. Will attach forecast artifacts when ready.
ethan: I'll prep a QBR slide: spend baseline, optimized projection, payback (savings vs enablement effort), and renewal risk note about embed-heavy features.
maya: thanks — one more: @deploy-bot any infra deploys on their dedicated pool today that could affect throughput?
deploy-bot: No deploys scheduled for that pool in the next 24h. :white_check_mark:
maya: Perfect. Sync at 15:30 to lock numbers and finalize the QBR slide deck. :calendar:
